concerns.text: The Constitution (Principle V – Versioning Discipline) requires that every artifact’s content hash be recorded in `state/projects/PROJ-737-assessing-uncertainty-quantification-tec.yaml`. Task T008 mentions logging and schema validation but does not include any step to compute and store artifact hashes, nor to update the `updated_at` timestamp. This omission weakens the constitutional requirement and must be added (e.g., a post‑validation step that writes hashes to the state file).
